value.rationale: Finite-data subnormal completion is a fundamental operator-theoretic problem. An explicit all-horizon sharp upper envelope under an operator-norm budget, simultaneously attained with unique extremizer, determines otherwise unknown later weights and distinguishes exact norm from cap-only feasibility. Its logarithmic delayed near-flat profile gives an exact and natural quantitative boundary to qualitative flatness propagation. This is a parameter-uniform structural result, not a table entry or an arbitrary slice.
